licenseNotes.changes: Selected seconds 0–219.958; resampled encoders/poses to 5 Hz using linear interpolation and quaternion SLERP; converted the pelvis IMU origin to the robot root; applied one constant world translation to place the start near the origin and estimated floor at z=0; inferred contact phases from FK sole height/speed; computed initialization and smoothing iterations. Pelvis accelerometer and gyro samples retain their original values and timestamps.

notes: Every completed outer LM iterate is saved, including iteration zero. Internal damping trials and CM-Opt feasibility retraction subiterations are not separate optimizer iterates. IK histories are per sample; contact initialization jointly solves sparse frames, with SE(3) interpolation for display. Export runs collect history and are not timing benchmarks.
